title: Implement the native Buffalo M Photo adapter

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Buffalo M adapter tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_buffalo_adapter.py

verify.summary: Fresh independent T2 verification passed all exact gates and a verifier-owned Buffalo M probe. It proved the configured SCRFD/native-alignment/normed_embedding path, immutable revision/assets/dimension, unit norm, FaceEngine compliance, early SFace and mismatch rejection, and absence of SFace/plugin/download/auto-selection/shared-contract paths. The dependency-starting pytest restarted but did not recreate the same exited-0 migrate container, and the required image digest remained unchanged.

The autopilot scheduler closed TASK-020 after Execution Attempt 1 and fresh independent T2 verification PASS for the native SCRFD-to-alignment-to-normed_embedding Buffalo M Photo path, immutable revision/assets, exact dimension/unit norm, FaceEngine compliance and anti-goals. Two bounded test-fixture fixes occurred before verdict; the observed Compose migrate recreation/restart completed successfully and required no recovery. No task failure budget was consumed.

evidence_required: FT-002-AC-008 RED: no production Buffalo M Photo adapter exposes the accepted SCRFD/native-alignment/normed_embedding path with revision and dimension checks; GREEN: one deterministic synthetic Photo follows that exact native path, returns a normalized dimension-valid embedding and rejects mismatched or SFace-derived inputs; decisive comparison: recorded native calls, revision metadata and negative fixtures match the AC; artifact: focused adapter-test output and redacted call-path record.
purpose: Implement the accepted native InsightFace Buffalo M Photo path behind the existing processing-owned engine boundary.
success_outcome: An eligible Buffalo M revision processes a synthetic Photo through SCRFD, native alignment and normed_embedding with exact revision/dimension checks and no SFace data path.
anti_goals: Do not implement realtime queries, a generic plugin system, model download or SFace behavior.
Do not normalize the two engine-native bbox, landmark, crop or alignment contracts into one invented format.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: The native path would require a second engine abstraction, online model download or automatic adapter selection.
Configured Buffalo M assets cannot be validated against the immutable revision without changing the accepted contract.

constraints: Use one direct Buffalo M implementation behind the existing FaceEngine boundary.
Model assets are configured and verified; execution never downloads or silently substitutes them.
Deterministic tests may inject native-call fixtures but must exercise the production adapter path.
invariants: Buffalo M consumes only its SCRFD/native-alignment result path.
Embedding dimension and asset identity match the immutable revision.
No OpenCV SFace intermediate is accepted.
verification_targets: Synthetic adapter proof records the SCRFD, native alignment and normed_embedding sequence plus mismatch rejection.
